known_limitations: No family has a candidate-bound named independent human scientific approval receipt.
R and Julia parity remains unsupported for the specialized frontier families.
Vector covariance execution and unit-safe scalarization remain pending under issue 843.
Sampling-acquisition harm is a scoped research question under issue 850, not an installed capability.
Stable promotion, release, publication, registry acceptance and parent closure remain separate gates.

invalidation_policy.default: any candidate change invalidates affected approval
invalidation_policy.bounded_delta_review: requires deterministic allowlist classification plus independent governance and affected-scientific-reviewer signatures
